Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER 4 OF 2000
SUPREME COURT
JUDGES (PENSIONARY BENEFITS)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
4 OF 2000
An Order to amend the Supreme Court Judges
(Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th March, 2000]
F.No.2(4)/2000-Pub., dated
30-3-2000.--The following Order made by the Chief Executive is hereby published
for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement:--(1) This Order may be called the Supreme Court Judges
(Pensionary Benefits) (Amendment) Order, 2000.
(2) it shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to take effect on the 1st day of February, 2000.

Amendment of Article 4 of C.E.O. No. 2 of 2000

CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER 4 OF 2000
SUPREME COURT
JUDGES (PENSIONARY BENEFITS)
(AMENDMENT) ORDER,
2000
CHIEF EXECUTIVE ORDER
4 OF 2000
An Order to amend the Supreme Court Judges
(Pensionary Benefits) Order, 2000
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 30th March, 2000]
F.No.2(4)/2000-Pub., dated
30-3-2000.--The following Order made by the Chief Executive is hereby published
for general information:--
2. Amendment of Article 4, of
C.E.O. No.2 of 2000:--In the Supreme Court Judges (Pensionary Benefits)
Order, 2000 (C.E.O. No.2 of 2000), in Article 4 for the full stop at the end a
colon shall be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added,
namely:-
"Provided
that commutation of pension shall be admissible to such Judge on the basis of
his actual age."
